newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian shares down, brokers pessimistic.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian shares down, brokers pessimistic.

text.p: Lithuanian shares dropped on Thursday in lethargic trade as many popular stocks were suspended, and brokers said they saw little reason to think the market would make a serious advance soon.
"No big change is expected next week," said Arvydas Jacikevichius, a broker with Suprema. "Turnover will be about the same."
Official list shares dropped 9.55 points to 922.01 points, while group A shares slipped 1.67 points to 1942.29 points. Litin G fell 23.48 points to 1764.49 points.

Trade in Lithuanian Energy, Liteksas and Calw, Rokishkis Cheese, Sanitas, Vilniaus Vingis, Vilniaus Bank and Lithuanian Savings Bank was suspended due to shareholders meetings, assimilation of share issues and other formalities.
Central market turnover was 634,000 litas versus 618,000 litas yesterday.

"It's very difficult to make forecasts now as sluggish trading continues and no interest is seen in stocks that were active earlier, like Birziai Dairy" said Kestutis Kupshys, a broker with Mendes Prior Europe.
Birziai Dairy bumped down to 9.70 litas from 10.25 litas after staying at that price for some time on meagre central market turnover of 12,000 litas.
"The buyer that was holding Birziai Dairy at 10.25 litas has disappeared," Kupshys said.
Alytaus Textile held steady at 0.20 litas but saw turnover of 348,000 litas on the central market.
"It looks like there is a process of holdings of small shareholders being combined into larger stakes and sold to larger investors," said Kupshys.
